build_MidasNet_with_weights: build a MidasNet model for monocular depth estimation loading pretrained weights from a file path
build_MidasNet_no_weights: build a MidasNet model for monocular depth estimation without loading any pretrained weights
run_MidasNet_forward: run a forward pass through MidasNet with an input image tensor to get depth output
review_MidasNet_init: review the MidasNet constructor to understand feature count, backbone, and non-negative output configuration
refactor_MidasNet_non_negative: refactor MidasNet to toggle the non_negative flag controlling whether output uses ReLU or Identity
